result.reasoning: This commit rewrote the iCalendar export logic to use the Biweekly library (Biweekly.write(ical).go()) across EventEmail.java, EventsExportEventsToICal.java, CalendarServlet.java, and CalendarExport.java, but never set a default/local timezone on the writer. The fix commit adds writer.getTimezoneInfo().setDefaultTimeZone(TimeZone.getDefault()) to each of these same call sites to ensure exported dates use the local timezone and correctly account for daylight savings — directly correcting the omission introduced when Biweekly-based export was first introduced in this commit.
